summary: Submitted a reachability successor for the now-asserted decided-regression defect: instead of an artificially delayed Prepare, the new leader's Prepare to node 5 is lost outright, node 5 keeps following the cut leader, and the public reconnected(2) call triggers PrepareReq → Prepare → Promise handled in the new leader's Accept phase → AcceptSync carrying its lower decided index. The experiment samples decided, entry status, leader decided and message flags to test whether one dropped message plus the library's own reconnect path reproduces the same Decided → Undecided → Decided regression. No interpretation added yet; the core witness and both runtime findings remain as recorded.
